title: Early phase clinical trial to evaluate the safety of the combination of immunotherapy with dendritic cells pulsed and tumor lysate, together with CAR-T cells targeting IL13Ra2, in patients with newly diagnosed diffuse intrinsic pontine glioma (DIPG)
official: Phase Ib, non-randomized, single-arm, open-label, single-center clinical trial to evaluate the safety of the first-in-human administration of the combination of dendritic cell (DC) immunization pulsed with tumor lysate and CAR-T cells targeting IL13Ra2 in patients with newly diagnosed diffuse intrinsic pontine glioma (DIPG)
summary: Main objective: To evaluate the safety of the first-in-human administration of a combination of dendritic cell (DC) immunisation (DIPG-DC) pulsed with lysates derived from a pool of 8 DIPG K27M-positive tumour cell lines (DIPG-lysate), together with intraventricular administration of anti-IL13Ra2 CAR-T cells (ARI0008), derived from T cells previously stimulated by DCs, in a cohort of patients with DIPG.
conditions: Patients with newly diagnosed diffuse intrinsic pontine glioma (DIPG)
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Written informed consent signed by the patient or legal representative and, if applicable, informed assent  (for minors aged ≥12 years).
2. Candidates for placement of an Ommaya reservoir with intraventricular catheter.
3. Fertile males and females must use a highly effective contraceptive method.
4. Newly diagnosed DIPG based on clinical-radiological criteria and/or histological and molecular  confirmation. Biopsied patients must show K27M mutation. Clinical and radiological criteria will be  assessed by the PI with support from a neuroradiologist at Hospital Sant Joan de Déu.
5. Prior neoadjuvant radiotherapy (standard of care for DIPG) before receiving the trial treatment.  Radiotherapy defined as 54–60 Gy in 1.8–2.2 Gy/fraction.
6. Age between 3 and 24 years inclusive.
7. Lansky performance score ≥50%. For patients ≥16 years, Karnofsky score ≥50%.
8. Life expectancy greater than 12 weeks.
9. Preserved bone marrow function: absolute neutrophil count >1,000/mcL, platelets >100,000/mcL  (independent of transfusions), haemoglobin >8 g/dL (may be transfusion-dependent).
10. Normal liver and kidney function, defined as: Total bilirubin ≤ 1.5 times the upper limit of normal (ULN) for age, unless the patient has Gilbert syndrome. ALT or AST < 2.5 times the ULN for age. Creatinine < 1.5 times the ULN.
11. Adequate venous access for leukapheresis.
Exclusion criteria:
1. Patients with disease progression or disseminated disease on MRI at diagnosis.
2. HIV+, HCV+, HBV+ patients or those not meeting the serological screening criteria described in Annex 5.
3. Pregnancy.
4. Breastfeeding.
5. Participation in another experimental study within the last 3 months.
6. Patients receiving other antitumor treatments. If previously treated, a washout period of at least 4 weeks is required.
7. Associated comorbidities that, in the investigator’s clinical judgement, cannot be adequately controlled and may compromise the patient’s ability to tolerate the study treatment.
8. Patients with neoplasms other than DIPG.
9. Patients requiring corticosteroid treatment at a daily dose >2 mg/day dexamethasone (or equivalent).
10. Patients for whom corticosteroid treatment cannot be suspended during the week prior to leukapheresis.
11. Patients receiving bevacizumab for pseudoprogression who do not show neurological stability.
12. Patients with uncontrolled infections.
